name: Software Development
description: Writing, reviewing, and shipping application code faster with AI pair programmers and code-generation agents.

subtypes.name: Frontend & UI code
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI-generated components from Figma or a prompt, with design-system conventions applied automatically

subtypes.name: Backend & APIs
subtypes.aiUseCase: Schema-aware code completion and AI-scaffolded endpoints from an API spec

subtypes.name: Mobile development
subtypes.aiUseCase: Cross-platform code generation and AI-assisted platform-specific debugging

subtypes.name: Autonomous coding agents
subtypes.aiUseCase: End-to-end ticket-to-PR agents that plan, write, test, and open pull requests unattended

subtypes.name: Code review & refactoring
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI static analysis, automated PR comments, and safe large-scale refactors

workflow.name: Development Cycle
workflow.noToolSuggestion: No dedicated tool in this registry — connect your backlog (Jira/Linear API or MCP server) to a general coding agent already listed above (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) for prioritization and estimation.

workflow.name: Integration with Jira
workflow.noToolSuggestion: No dedicated tool — Atlassian's Jira REST API or its official Jira MCP server, paired with any coding agent already in this stack, covers ticket creation and task linking.

name: Product & Ideation

subtypes.name: Market & competitor research
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI-synthesized competitor teardowns and market-trend analysis from live web data

subtypes.name: User research synthesis
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI clustering of interview transcripts and survey responses into ranked themes

subtypes.name: PRD & spec writing
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI-drafted requirements and edge cases from a rough one-paragraph brief

subtypes.name: Roadmapping
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI-assisted prioritization scoring (RICE/ICE) and cross-team dependency mapping

subtypes.name: Rapid prototyping
subtypes.aiUseCase: Prompt-to-UI generation producing a clickable prototype in minutes

name: QA & Testing
description: Generating, running, and maintaining automated tests, and finding regressions before customers do.

subtypes.name: Functional test automation
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI-generated test scripts from user stories, with self-healing selectors

subtypes.name: Visual regression testing
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI visual-diffing that ignores rendering noise and flags only real UI regressions

subtypes.name: Performance testing
subtypes.aiUseCase: AI load simulation with predictive bottleneck detection before release

subtypes.name: Test case generation
subtypes.aiUseCase: Auto-generated edge-case tests drawn from requirements and past defect patterns

workflow.name: Test Planning
workflow.noToolSuggestion: No dedicated tool — a general-purpose AI assistant (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) reading your requirements doc via API or MCP can draft test cases and flag coverage gaps.

workflow.name: Release Readiness
workflow.noToolSuggestion: No dedicated tool — pull CI/CD and test results via API into a general AI assistant for a synthesized go/no-go summary.
